_comment: SINGLE SOURCE of parameters. Starred values are DERIVED from dimensional values by the frozen nondimensionalisation (blueprint §5; frozen formulation §12-13). Do not edit starred values directly.

provenance_labels.C66,K6,R6: derived by frozen symmetry relations 2C66=C11-C12, K6=K1-K2-K3, 2R6=R1-R2
provenance_labels.rho_w: DECLARED identification rho_w = rho (no independent phason mass density in literature)
provenance_labels.c_e: SURROGATE (500 J/(kg K), declared); nondimensional role c_e* = 1 exactly (F1: absorbed into thermal-row normalisation)
provenance_labels.D_w: literature-derived: D_w = 1/C_w, C_w = 4.8e-19 m^3 s/kg from chellappan2015 eq.(3)+p.8; mobility/friction distinction enforced
provenance_labels.tau0: DECLARED computational parameter (swept 1e-13..1e-11 s in design; production study uses tau0* values)
provenance_labels.k11: DECLARED choice 6 W/(m K); li2017 reports 5.3 - discrepancy genuine and unresolved
provenance_labels.k0: DECLARED nondimensionalisation scale 2*pi*1e6 m^-1 (reference wavelength 1 um); NEVER a working wavenumber
